<!--
This file exists so GitHub's community-profile check recognizes an issue
template. The actual, structured forms live in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
and are shown when you open a new issue.
-->

Thanks for reporting an issue.

- **Bug**: use the "Bug report" form (include a minimal reproduction, redact
  keys as `sk-REDACTED`, and add the request id for 5xx errors).
- **Wrong price or model count**: see
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/AIWaveAPI/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
  — check https://aiwave.live/api/pricing first and include the date.
- **Feature idea**: use the "Feature request" form.
- **Question**: use
  [Discussions](https://github.com/AIWaveAPI/aiwave-quickstart/discussions).
- **Security issue**: do **not** open a public issue — see
  [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/AIWaveAPI/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
